newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Libyan prime minister leaves Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Libyan prime minister leaves Morocco.

text.p: Libyan Prime Minister Abdelmajid al-Gu'ud left Morocco on Sunday after talks about promoting trade and encouraging joint investments and cooperation.
The official Moroccan news agency MAP said Gu'ud was seen off by Moroccan Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali with whom he had discussed boosting economic links.
MAP said that Gu'ud, who arrived in Morocco on Friday, carried greetings to King Hassan from Libyan leader Colonel Muammar Gaddafi.
